# Native FMOD/fmodstudio names with REAL door implementations
# in mono_fmod_door.cpp. Everything else in celeste.implmap gets
# a fail-visible function from gen-failvisible.py.
# NOTE: the FMOD C# wrapper binds the shared ChannelControl
# functions (Stop/SetVolume/...) through FMOD_ChannelGroup_*
# native names for BOTH Channel and ChannelGroup handles; the
# door dispatches on the handle type.
